def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find each rectangular canvas of 0s containing a colored motif; tile
    # the motif pattern to fill the canvas. Pattern's phase is anchored to
    # the motif's top-left 3x3 block.
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=g[r][c]
        if color in (0,8): continue
        # Motif's minimal bounding box, derive dimensions from connected colored cells
        cells={(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x]==color}
        # isolate local components in case same color occurs elsewhere
        comp={(r,c)}; stack=[(r,c)]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop()
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if q in cells and q not in comp: comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        # motif should have multiple cells; define full original zero rectangle
        top=min(y for y,x in comp); bot=max(y for y,x in comp)
        left=min(x for y,x in comp); right=max(x for y,x in comp)
        ph,pw=bot-top+1,right-left+1
        # rectangular region from neighboring zeros, expand bounds
        T,B,L,R=top,bot,left,right
        while T>0 and all(g[T-1][x] in (0,color) for x in range(L,R+1)): T-=1
        while B+1<h and all(g[B+1][x] in (0,color) for x in range(L,R+1)): B+=1
        while L>0 and all(g[y][L-1] in (0,color) for y in range(T,B+1)): L-=1
        while R+1<w and all(g[y][R+1] in (0,color) for y in range(T,B+1)): R+=1
        if (B-T+1)*(R-L+1) <= len(comp): continue
        pat={(y-top,x-left) for y,x in comp}
        for y in range(T,B+1):
          for x in range(L,R+1):
            if g[y][x]!=8: g[y][x]=color if ((y-top)%ph,(x-left)%pw) in pat else 0
    return g
